title: Chutia Jatir Itihas Aru Loka-sanskriti Vol. 1, 2
author: Surjyakanta Khanikar
description: Comprehensive regional history exploring the medieval interactions, matrimonial bonds, agrarian partnerships, and boundary treaties between the Chutia kingdom and early Tai settlements in Upper Assam.
